title: Bound on path-length powers
statement: Let $P$ be a finite list of paths on the $n$-coordinate Boolean cube, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. If every path in the list has length at most $k$, then the sum of $2^{\text{length}(p)}$ over the list is at most the length of the list times $2^k$.
